name: Storista
summary: Shopify app that turns TikTok, Reels and UGC clips into shoppable video widgets — carousels, stories, grids and spotlights — with auto-sync from TikTok and Instagram.
best_for: Shopify stores that already produce TikTok or Reels content and want it on the storefront as shoppable video, with the free tier's unlimited views making it cheap to test whether social video converts on your product pages at all
skip_if: you have no UGC or short-form pipeline to feed it — the widget displays content, it does not create any — or you want automatic product-to-video tagging without paying $49 a month for it
honest_knock:
The first thing to know is how much this ladder has moved. When we first read it on 23 August 2026 the free plan stopped at 10 videos, a $15 Basic plan stopped at 50, and storista.io sold a different product altogether, an AI UGC video generator priced per render. Read again on 10 October 2026, the Shopify listing and storista.io sell the same widget, the free plan lists unlimited videos, and the paid tiers are called Starter, Growth and Scale. One older line survives: the FAQ on storista.io/pricing still says 10 videos on the free plan. If the cap matters to your plan, ask which statement governs before you build on it.

Second, read the headline against the pricing table. AI Smart Tagging is the feature the app leads its pitch with, and it appears on Growth at $49 and above. On Free and Starter you tag products to videos yourself.

Third, the rating deserves its detail. On 10 October 2026 it was 4.9 from 54 reviews: 51 five-star, two four-star and one one-star. In August the same listing showed 5.0 from 49, which was a rounding rather than a perfect record, and that is worth checking on any app whose average sits on or near the ceiling.

Finally, the data access. When we read it in August 2026 the listing stated the app views customer device and activity data and can view and edit customers, products, store analytics, custom data and Shopify admin. That is a wide grant for a widget that displays video, and it belongs in your processing register whatever you decide about the product.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, removing Storista's branding and adding Instagram/TikTok auto-sync, GEO/SEO optimisation and multiple products per video, with a 14-day free trial
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-10 on apps.shopify.com/storista-stories, listed as “Storista Shoppable Videos UGC”, and on storista.io/pricing) Four tiers. Free lists unlimited videos and views, Shop app integration and manual import from Instagram and TikTok, and keeps Storista branding on the widget; the FAQ on storista.io/pricing still says the free plan covers 10 videos, so the vendor's own pages disagree on the free cap. Starter is $15 a month and adds GEO/SEO optimisation, multiple products per video, manual videos on product pages, removal of the Storista branding, auto-sync from Instagram and TikTok and manual caption uploads. Growth is $49 a month and adds AI Smart Tagging, advanced analytics, auto captions in 40 languages, A/B tests and smart videos on product pages. Scale is $199 a month for Shopify Plus stores and adds VIP support, multiple stores and custom widgets. Every paid tier carries a 14-day free trial, and storista.io says you are not charged if you cancel during it. storista.io advertises yearly billing at 20% off without printing the yearly amounts. Charges are in USD. When we first read the listing on 23 August 2026 the tiers were called Basic and Business, Free stopped at 10 videos and Basic at 50, and storista.io sold a different product, AI-generated UGC video priced per render; read on 10 October 2026, storista.io sells this same widget. Developer Storista LLC, Sheridan, Wyoming; the app launched on 19 February 2021 and had 54 reviews at a 4.9 average on 10 October 2026.
